invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null map via Collectors.toMap, which never returns null.
The method invokes data.stream(), so if data were null a NullPointerException would occur; thus, data is non-null at exit.
The function is passed into a wrapper and then used for mapping, requiring it to be non-null for correct operation.
At most one entry per pair generated from each element in data; duplicate keys would overwrite prior values, but never increase result size over input.
